g.text: At T=6, accumulation dominates the measured phase budget
Independent profiles · P=2 · five repetitions/variant · logarithmic percentage scale
Each sample uses every phase from its maximum-kernel rank. Diamonds: medians; ranges: observed min–max.
*V2 has no private-buffer merge: this slot records timer/control overhead. Independent medians are not additive.
Accumulation includes clearing, distances, updates and barriers; this does not isolate pure atomic waiting.
